SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN governance.process_status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN governance.process_status = 'PROCESSING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS processing_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN governance.process_status = 'RESOLVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS resolved_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN governance.process_status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completed_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN governance.process_status = 'IGNORED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ignored_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN governance.id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS missing_governance_count FROM tb_ai_log_module_config config INNER JOIN tb_ai_log_issue_group issue_group ON config.environment = issue_group.environment AND config.system_code = issue_group.system_code AND config.module_code = issue_group.module_code LEFT JOIN tb_ai_log_issue_group_governance governance ON governance.issue_group_id = issue_group.id
config.enabled = 1 AND config.environment = #{filter.environment} AND config.system_code = #{filter.systemCode} AND config.module_code = #{filter.moduleCode} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_ai_log_error_event event WHERE event.issue_group_id = issue_group.id AND event.log_date BETWEEN #{filter.startDate} AND #{filter.endDate} )

SELECT DISTINCT event.issue_group_id, event.environment, event.system_code, event.module_code
ORDER BY event.issue_group_id

SELECT event.log_date, event.environment, event.system_code, event.module_code, SUM(event.occurrence_count) AS occurrence_count
GROUP BY event.log_date, event.environment, event.system_code, event.module_code ORDER BY event.environment, event.system_code, event.module_code, event.log_date
SELECT environment, system_code, module_code FROM tb_ai_log_module_config WHERE enabled = 1 ORDER BY environment, system_code, module_code
